title: QNAP NAS Malware Remover Command Injection Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of QNAP NAS. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Malware Remover application. A crafted TAR file in the file system can trigger execution of a system call composed from a user-supplied string. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the admin user.
